0x00008C.en:
An era known as the New Western
Calendar.

The wars against the aliens and the
visitors from parallel worlds have
ended, and a short while has passed...

Aidoneus Island, off the Marquesas
Islands in the South Pacific - impact
site of "Meteor-3", the meteorite the
alien Aerogaters sent to Earth, and
onetime headquarters of the "Divine
Crusaders (DC)", the military
organization that ignited civil war
across the Earth Sphere... Its
surrounding waters were sealed off, and
for a time the island itself vanished
from the stage of history.

0x0002C0.en:
But behind the scenes, a certain plan
was steadily moving forward.

It called for a special operations force
answering directly to the President of
the Earth Federation Government, built
on ISA tactics - a blitzkrieg doctrine
pairing a mobile battleship serving as a
carrier with the humanoid mobile weapons
it deploys... Its codename: "GS".

"GS" is a military organization
independent of the Earth Federation
Army, and its primary duty is the
execution of the President's special
mandates in military affairs.

Under the command of two Special
Presidential Advisors, the
refortification of Aidoneus Island
pressed ahead, and the fruits of
numerous projects - one new weapon after
another - were gathered there. Yet the
true nature of "GS" was kept hidden; to
the world, it was merely a test unit for
new weaponry.

Can "GS" truly become the new sword that
guards the Earth Sphere?

Powers and ambitions of every kind set
time and space trembling... and open the
gate to another world...
